transcript.answer: No. Otto's rules forbid it. FR-034 of the support-agent-tms-access spec says tool definitions registered in `apps/api` MUST NOT declare a customer id, company id or account number in their `inputSchema`. That applies at any depth and to English or Danish spellings. `registerTools` (`apps/api/src/tools/registerTools.ts`) must refuse such a definition before the registry holds it. ADR-001 gives the reason: the `customerNumber` for a TMS call is always derived server-side from the authenticated identity and is never a model-supplied tool input. A test, `apps/api/test/customerBoundary.test.ts`, checks that registration refuses these tools, including one that nests `orderer_customer_number` inside an object in an array. Issue #560 is the task that added this guard. I read these requirements and the issue's description of the guard. I did not read the guard code itself.

judgements.reason: The answer says no tool may declare a customer id, company id or account number at any depth, in English or Danish spellings, that registerTools refuses such a definition, and that a test enforces this; its description of the test differs slightly from the gold answer's but does not contradict it.
